subject.title: fix(acp): skip unadvertised thinking/effort config keys instead of throwing

question: Should unsupported ACP reasoning controls be skipped only when inherited from defaults, or should explicit caller-selected values also become advisory?
rationale: The current patch changes an established explicit-control failure into silent fallback, while the narrower provenance-aware implementation changes persisted session metadata and needs a canonical compatibility choice.

options.title: Preserve explicit intent
options.body: Track explicit versus default reasoning provenance and skip only unsupported inherited values.

options.title: Make reasoning advisory
options.body: Intentionally allow unsupported explicit `thinking` and `effort` values to be silently ignored across ACP backends.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit intent
recommendation.body: Track explicit versus default reasoning provenance and skip only unsupported inherited values.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows direct ownership of the narrowed optional-control contract and broad contribution across the affected ACP paths.
